# instrumentation

## Overview
Instrumentation logging and health metric tracking utilities (Instrumentation, HealthUtils).

## Interface
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.instrumentation.Instrumentation
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.instrumentation.HealthUtils
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.instrumentation.Base64

## Invariants
- Collects performance and error metrics for DAS communication.

## Side Effects
- Outputs diagnostic performance metrics and health logs.
